title: [LOGGED OUT] Home "Special offer" card is shown and "Check our store" opens the Store

steps.text: Open https://site.ludus-game.com/ in the browser and wait until the page has finished loading.
If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss".
steps.saw: Banner shown; clicked Dismiss; banner gone (screenshot retaken after the closing animation).

steps.text: Is a card with the ribbon "Special offer" shown?
steps.saw: Card with red ribbon Special offer (URUK BUNDLE, 230%) is shown.

steps.text: Does the card show "You will get:", item amounts and an "Available:" line?
steps.saw: Card shows You will get: with amounts 6, 2000, 100000 and Available: 5/5.

steps.text: Click "Check our store" on the card.
steps.saw: Clicked the Check our store link on the card; navigated to the Store.

steps.text: Is the address now https://site.ludus-game.com/store (with or without a final "/")?
